readme: Rear three-quarter party paintings for the perspectives round (CANDIDATES). Each PNG is a rembg cut-out served by the worktree dev server at `path`; the sidecar beside it (rear34.json) has the full settings. baselineY = the feet row (plant it on the ground). scale = PoseFrame.scale when the idle is the reference pose, so the rear figure is as tall as the idle. facingInImage 'away-right' = faces into the frame turned toward screen-right; 'away' = near-straight back view. None of these is mirrored.

items.subject: tidus
items.notes: Sword in the RIGHT hand and the blue pauldron on the RIGHT shoulder, as in the idle. Residual: the red knit sleeve sits on the right arm (the idle has it on the left). Blade a lighter cyan than the idle's deep blue. Stepping toward screen-right; no cheek visible. baselineY is the back (left) foot; the blade tip hangs 16 px lower (it is nearer the camera).

items.subject: yuna
items.notes: Staff held upright in the RIGHT hand, ring head up (the idle holds it low and diagonal in the right hand). Obi bow, detached pink sleeves, hakama print, bob all read. Near-straight back view, body only slightly toward screen-right; the left sleeve flies out to the left.

items.subject: kimahri
items.notes: Spear upright in the RIGHT hand. POST: the render's long thin horn was trimmed by hand to a short jagged stub (alpha only, tools/zz-persp-art/post.py erase), so he has ONE broken horn. Head in profile toward screen-right (more than a sliver of cheek). Spearhead gold, not the idle's silver; tail tuft blue, not white. baselineY is the feet; the spear butt ends 9 px lower.

items.subject: yuna-white-mage
items.notes: Rod in the RIGHT hand, head (gold ring) low and behind her as in the idle. Hood up with the gold crescent, red zigzag trim, white boots. Drift: an open back with a pink panel (the idle's robe is closed); the rod head is a plain ring, not the idle's openwork disc. Straight back view.

items.subject: rikku-dark-knight
items.notes: Stage-2 reroll pick (replaces B2 #1, whose armour had drifted to gold and bronze with orange and teal panels): the idle's dark navy-black armour with gold trim, chainmail skirt, dark armoured legs, the blonde braided ponytail; the right hand on the pommel of a big planted greatsword with a navy, gold and lavender blade. Turned toward screen-right. Drift: a dark blue cape panel with orange tips hangs at her left; outlines a little orange; the idle's hands are both on the hilt.

items.subject: paine-warrior
items.notes: Sword planted at her right, hands on the pommel. Swept silver hair, studded choker, off-shoulder jacket, corset, red belt, sheer black thigh-highs, chunky combat boots. Drift: a red strappy top shows between the shoulder blades; the crossguard has white wings (the idle's is red gothic). Near-straight back view, a little toward screen-right.

items.subject: seymour-flux-body
items.notes: Seymour Flux (FFX, Chapter I) from behind, floating, arms spread wide: the blue robe with red trim, the green sash, a tall swept-up crest of light blue hair. Straight back view. Drift: the crest is spikier than the idle's fan of thick locks (no pink tips); legs hang instead of crossing. baselineY is the robe hem (he floats, as the idle). Method A (no skeleton), third batch: the word 'fan-shaped crest' drew giant fans.

items.subject: ffx2-bahamut
items.notes: Bahamut (FFX-2, Chapter IV) from behind: dorsal plates down the spine, wings spread, the head turned in profile toward screen-LEFT (toward the party), the tail curling right. POST: rembg left white background trapped between the neck and the right wing; keyed out (post.py keywhite). Drift: the wings are a more saturated red than the idle's salmon; no violet glow on the scales.

items.subject: tidus
items.notes: 2x of the rear34 pick, refined at denoise 0.4 (crisper hair, straps, pauldron than a plain upscale). Figure 1844 px head to feet, so a mid-thigh crop (about 60 %) fills about 1100 px: 1:1 or smaller on a 1080 frame. Same chirality and residuals as rear34. baselineY is the back foot; the blade tip hangs 33 px lower.

items.subject: yuna-white-mage
items.notes: 2x of the rear34 pick, refined at denoise 0.4. Figure 2066 px head to feet; a mid-thigh crop fills about 1200 px. Same drift as rear34 (open back panel, plain ring rod head).

items.subject: gagazet
items.notes: Looking back down the trail (FFX, Chapter I): a level eye line with the distant ridges across about 45 % of the height and the trail dropping into the valley below it. img2img from today's plate MIRRORED with the horizon moved up 17 % (top cropped, near snow stretched), repainted at denoise 0.75 in the plate's palette; no moon (it is behind the camera). Alternate with today's framing (horizon about 60 %): plates/gagazet/D/cand-11.png.

items.subject: bevelle-underground
items.notes: The other end of the machina hall (FFX-2, Chapter IV): the floor runs away to a door, the vanishing point at about 48 %, a great round sunburst seal above it, orange lamps down both walls, a wet reflective deck. img2img from today's plate MIRRORED with the horizon moved up 28 %, repainted at denoise 0.70. Alternate with today's framing (a giant blast door, vanishing point about 62 %): plates/bevelle-underground/D/cand-11.png.

items.subject: proscenium
items.notes: PICK. Ink & Gold read literally: a carved gilded arch with filigree and a sunburst crest at the top centre, violet-black velvet curtains with gold rope tie-backs and tassels, a black swag behind gold scallops, a dark apron with lit footlights. The opening (x 200-1720, y 118-1010, top corners r 70) is alpha 0 except a warm footlight wash over its bottom ~90 px (alpha up to 0.42). The lower corners are dark for the HUD. POST: the opening cut and the footlight glows (proscenium.py finish). For FFX-2 chapters the Ink & Gold accent is pyre pink; the arch is left gold (a painted object), tint it if the main session wants the pink accent.

items.subject: proscenium
items.notes: ALTERNATE: the classic theatre look, crimson velvet curtains and swag with gold fringe, gold columns and crest (the stand-in's colours). Blood red is the enemies' colour in Ink & Gold, hence not the pick. Same opening, glow and post as the pick.

items.subject: floor-gagazet

mapping.orientation: image top = world -z (the far side, toward today's backdrop), image left = world -x; the same mapping as bevelle-underground.ts (row y / size = (z + 28) / 46)

items.notes: Moonlit snowfield from directly above: wind-carved drifts on a diagonal, pockets of cracked blue ice, a footprint trail, dark rocks at the edges, a calm arena in the middle (x -4..5, z -8..3). Weak: the rocks came out small and few; the ice pockets glow like light sources. 1024 img2img from a layout sketch (floors.py), RealESRGAN x4, then a smoothstep falloff to the fog colour over the outer 10 %.

items.subject: floor-bevelle

mapping.orientation: image top = world -z (the far side, toward today's backdrop), image left = world -x; the same mapping as bevelle-underground.ts (row y / size = (z + 28) / 46)
mapping.edgeFalloff: smoothstep to #32272d (the plate's horizon band, the scene's own fog source) over the outer 10 %
mapping.hole: world (2.4, -7.8) = px (2260, 1799); the open shaft is the scene's HOLE ellipse (rx 2.5, rz 1.6 units), the cracks and rim reach about the 7.6 x 4.9 units REQUEST.md asks

items.notes: Riveted steel deck from directly above: 3-unit plates with grating slots, cyan-lit seams around (not across) the arena, warm lamp spill along both side walls, oil sheen, and the hole at the scene's position, glowing cyan-white with cracks radiating through the plates. Weak: it reads as a punched hole with cracks, less as torn-up plating; the small brass inlay I sketched did not survive. Third pass: a brass ring I first drew round the arena ran through the hole and the checkpoint painted the two as one neat round porthole (cand-3), a masked repaint of the hole region failed twice (cand-5, cand-6).
